description: Audit a web page for SEO + GEO (generative-engine-optimization). Returns a structured JSON report: meta tags, an SEO score with per-category breakdown + issues, a GEO score with breakdown + issues, and a combined percentage. PAID x402 service (USDC on Base) — needs a funded wallet on the MCP server.

mode.description: Which audit(s) to run: 'both' (default), 'seo' only, or 'geo' only

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to process

name: seo_audit
